description: Start a private Frase workflow that may create research, briefs, articles, images, or optimizations and auto-apply content changes. Returns a run ID.

content_id.description: Existing content ID to run against (e.g. optimization playbooks like Quick Update)

site_id.description: Pin the run to a site. Required for brief-creating system playbooks (e.g. SEO Blog Post) when no content_id is given.

name: run_playbook
